sourceFile: 92. BRS-161014 Report test Jig CM+CP NG after check by Jig master Yoke 01.09.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Core jig NG versus normal comparison is plausible, but the draft includes a likely spurious measurement outcome and omits key decision evidence.
issues: Measurement outcome appears derived from header/count columns, not true measurements.
Decision row supporting usability is not cited in the case.
Changed factor should be jig condition only, not material.
Important context on 14/45 sorted NG jigs is omitted.
Outcome judgement ignores stated conclusion that hearing NG was not yoke-offset related.
correctionPlan: Remove the measurement-1 outcome unless actual measurement rows exist.
Set changed factor to Normal jig versus Test Jig NG Type 1 and Type 2.
Add rows 11 and 33 as evidence for context and conclusion.
Keep function test subresults with rows 15, 17, and 19.
Add limitation that sample sizes differ and NG cause attribution comes from decision text.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations support table comparisons, but conclusion and measurement citations are insufficient.
